idea: Build CrownCut, a luxury barber salon booking app with haircut & beard service menu, master stylist selection, appointment time slot picker, and booking receipt confirmation

screens.purpose: Presents the high-end salon's brand story, active master stylists, and featured grooming packages in an immersive dark-mode luxury interface.
screens.userGoal: Explore signature salon aesthetics, review featured grooming experiences, and initiate an exclusive booking.
exitActions: Tap Stylist Avatar -> Master Stylist Profile Screen
Tap 'Book Experience' CTA -> Service Menu & Concierge Preferences Screen
Tap 'View VIP Pass' floating card -> VIP Digital Receipt & Pass Screen
screens.layoutStructure: Top ambient video/hero banner + horizontally scrolling Master Stylist carousel + vertical list of Signature Grooming Packages + sticky bottom navigation bar
uiComponents: Hero Video Carousel with Salon Ambiance
Master Stylist Spotlight Cards
Signature Package Collection List
Active Booking Status Bar
Quick Reservation Floating CTA

Tap Stylist Selector during Service Concierge flow
exitActions: Tap 'Select Master Stylist' -> Service Menu & Concierge Preferences Screen
Tap Back Button -> Lounge Showcase Screen

screens.purpose: Allows clients to select haircut and beard services while customizing bespoke pre-appointment amenities.
screens.userGoal: Curate custom grooming services and specify personal lounge environment preferences (beverage, ambient lighting, music genre).
entryPoints: Tap 'Book Experience' on Lounge Showcase Screen
Tap 'Reserve with Stylist' from Stylist Profile Screen
exitActions: Tap 'Proceed to Schedule' -> Schedule & Time Slot Selector Screen

navigationFlows.trigger: Tap 'Active VIP Pass Card' from Lounge
Launch app in Barber Staff Mode

globalRules: All tap targets must adhere to a minimum size of 48x48dp for premium touch ergonomics
Strict dark-mode first design palette using rich obsidian black, metallic champagne gold, and soft warm bronze
Optimistic UI updates applied to booking lock timers and concierge preference selections
Offline caching for VIP passes ensuring QR codes load seamlessly even without cellular reception
Haptic feedback triggers on primary touch interactions to elevate the tactile, high-end feel of the software

sharedComponents.name: Gold Accent Primary Action CTA Button

designRequirementsForStitch.typographyGuidelines: Editorial serif headers (Playfair Display) for luxury titles paired with geometric sans-serif (Inter) for body text and operational metrics. Scaled: 32pt Display, 24pt Hero Header, 16pt Body, 12pt Monospace Badge
designRequirementsForStitch.spacingAndGrid: Strict 8pt spatial layout grid system using 8px, 16px, 24px, 32px, 48px, 64px structural tokens
componentVariantsNeeded: Primary CTA Button (Default, Pressed, Loading Gold Spinner, Disabled)
Concierge Option Tile (Unselected Dark, Selected Gold Glow, Disabled)
Time Slot Pill (Available Slate, Held Gold, Occupied Dimmed)
Stylist Portfolio Avatar (Default Round, Selected Gold Crown Border)
motionAndMicroInteractions: Parallax gold shimmer effect on VIP Pass rotation (30fps gyro-bound)
Smooth 250ms ease-out spring transitions for screen entries and sheet overlays
Tactile 0.96x button depress scale animation on physical tap
